name: A Little Help From My Friends
summary: Spraggle Frock needs you to guide Ringo to him at Marshal's Refuge. If Ringo faints along the way, Spraggle's Canteen can revive him.

sections.title: Ringo's Journey
sections.body: Ringo is to be brought to Spraggle Frock at Marshal's Refuge. You guide him there, keeping Spraggle's Canteen ready in case Ringo faints. His arrival depends on reaching Spraggle, and the canteen is there to help him continue.

faq.q: Who do I bring to Spraggle?
faq.answer: You guide Ringo to Spraggle Frock at Marshal's Refuge.
Ringo is headed to Spraggle Frock at Marshal's Refuge.
Use Spraggle's Canteen to revive Ringo if he faints.

attribution: In-game quest text: A Little Help From My Friends
